name: Octopus Biosafety SA
summary: Octopus Biosafety SA engages in designing, manufacturing, and marketing of mobile, autonomous, intelligent, and modular robots for poultry industry in France and internationally. It offers XO, a continuous litter treatment, and environmental and animal monitoring solution for poultry farming; T-MOOV, a robot that keeps the birds moving and reduces the count of floor eggs; and Easy-LIT, an electric scarifier that helps in simplifying the maintenance of litter without noise and dust, as well as without lifting the equipment and risking injury to the poultry. Octopus Biosafety SA was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Auray, France.
